routes.label: online: around one to two weeks from ICA's receipt
over the counter: around one to two weeks from ICA's receipt
abroad: around four to six weeks

free: a newborn citizen's first passport applied for online on or before the first birthday
note: The same fee for a child's: the page names no other. A lost or damaged passport adds a penalty of S$50 the first time and S$100 after. The fee abroad is not on the page read. ICA reworded the page by 2026-11-03 (last updated 30 October 2026): its fees, times and validity stayed as they were read on 2026-10-28, and it added that up to 9 months left on a previous passport carry over into a 5-year one, which isn't modelled.

sources.title: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, Singapore, Apply for a passport
sources.said: Fees A S$70 fee is payable if you apply online. An S$80 fee is payable for application submitted over counter at ICA Services Centre or at Singapore Overseas Mission. If your passport is lost or damaged, you will need to pay the passport fee stated above, as well as the following non-refundable penalty fees to replace it: S$50 for the first replacement S$100 for subsequent replacements ... From 1 January 2020, newborn SCs will enjoy a waiver of the first passport application fee if: The application is submitted on or before the child's first birthday The application is submitted via MylCA portal Processing Time Local The processing time for a passport is around 1 to 2 weeks upon ICA's receipt of the application. The processing time may be up to 4 weeks if your photograph does not meet the requirements or if your application involves changes to your principal name and/or surname ... Overseas The processing time for a passport is around 4 to 6 weeks upon ICA's receipt of the application ... Singapore passports are valid for 10 years for citizens aged 16 and above, and 5 years for citizens below 16. For 5-year passports, up to 9 months of remaining validity from your previous passport can be carried over.
